data.name: Edited Videos Trick AI Robots into Harmful Actions on Baby Doll
data.summary: Robocurve PBC tested five frontier AI models like Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-6 Astra on real robotic arms with unsafe tasks from their RoboHarm benchmark, such as stabbing objects or pouring water into toasters. Unaltered footage led to harmful attempts in 27% of trials, blurred footage in 88%, and edited footage in 97%—reaching near-100% for the doll disguised as an apple. The simple visual edits bypassed safety refusals without code changes, highlighting vulnerabilities in how embodied AI handles manipulated perceptions. No real harm occurred, as props like dolls and empty bottles were used.

data.name: Three Foreign Nationals Indicted for $129 Million AI Impersonation Fraud
data.summary: Federal prosecutors in New York charged Jacob Soall, Sharon Hazan, and Guy Sheetrit with wire fraud and identity theft for a scheme that used advanced AI to mimic corporate leaders and lawyers. Over 18 months from mid-2024 to early 2026, they targeted U.S. firms like Missouri and California hospitals, a Rhode Island bank, a Massachusetts mutual fund, a Florida pet food company, and a UK fintech that lost $11.5 million. Funds moved through global accounts to cryptocurrency, with the trio arrested in Spain and the UK awaiting extradition. Officials warn businesses to verify urgent payments through trusted channels amid rising AI fraud risks.

data.name: AI Users Shift to Hermes Agent After Grok Bot Model Switch
data.summary: Fingerprint tests reveal Grok Bot now runs on OpenAI’s gpt-6-astra/6.1-sol, ditching the prior Claude Opus 5.5 amid high costs noted by SpaceXAI leaders. Hermes Agent, an open-source tool from Nous Research, gains fans for letting users swap any model—local or cloud—while offering customizable memory, token caching up to 94%, and light resource use. Longtime users praise its evolving desktop setup, multi-platform messaging, and skill-building that feels truly personal, even as some note minor hiccups compared to Grok's easy X integration.
